title: CoverageSignal
description: Code-coverage signals from tools such as LCOV, Istanbul, or Cobertura. Represents per-file line, branch, and function coverage data.

source.description: Metadata about the coverage tool and format that produced these signals.

format.description: Coverage report format used as input.

version.description: Version of the tool that produced the coverage data.

fileCoverage.description: Coverage data for a single source file.

filePath.description: Path to the source file, relative to the repository root.

linesCovered.description: Number of lines executed at least once.

linesTotal.description: Total number of instrumentable lines in the file.

branchesCovered.description: Number of branches executed at least once, if available.

branchesTotal.description: Total number of branches in the file, if available.

functionCoverage.description: Execution data for a single function.

name.description: Name of the function as reported by the coverage tool.

line.description: One-based line number where the function is defined.

executionCount.description: Number of times the function was executed during the test run.
